product_metadata.title: DilaBee – Empty Plastic Spray Bottle – 16 oz Spray Bottles for Cleaning Solutions - 100% Leak Proof with Mist Stream and Off Trigger Settings - for Home, Garden, and More (Pack of 8)
features: REVOLUTIONARY 100% LEAK PREVENTION TECHNOLOGY - Don’t settle for a weak and cheap, leaky spray bottle. With Dilabee’s advanced leak prevention design you can be sure that not 1 extra drop of liquid will be wasted, making them 100% leakproof.

VERSATILE CONCEPT - Designed using durable and lightweight HDPE plastic, these reusable plastic spray bottles from Dilabee are ideal for a multitude of both indoor or outdoor, household and commercial tasks. Use them for cleaning, gardening, haircare, car de-icing and more!

BESPOKE SPRAY DESIGN - An adjustable nozzle provides a strong stream distribution, light mist or anything in between. The simple trigger mechanism is easy to pull with no stiff or uncomfortable resistance.

HOME & COMMERCIAL / INDUSTRIAL USES Dilabee spray bottels can be used for multi-purposes, Use them for cleaning solutions around the house, pet, cat, lawn and garden, misting and watering plants, succulents, herbs, ironing, laundry, car detailing, janitorial. Make your own homemade diy cleaner mister or just use with water to cool yourself.

USER SATISFACTION - With a comfortable shape designed to fit snuggly into an adult’s hand, these bottles have truly been constructed with user experience and satisfaction at the core of our manufacturing process. Freshen up your pillow cases, store and spray essential oils and clean organically - so many options in the same place.
description: This essential set of four, 16 oz spray bottles is fantastic for home use NOT FOR CHEMICALS USE. The highly accurate spray nozzle coupled with the original 100% no-leak mechanism will set off your cleaning or gardening tasks to a perfect start. Buy economy sized liquid cleaning products in bulk for less and decant the contents into these trusty home use bottles. Ensure that the nozzle is tightly secured to the bottle top before use, to prevent drips and spillages. The 16-ounce capacity, plastic bottle is perfect for an all-natural household looking to create their own cleaning recipes for a healthier home. Try a homemade drain cleaner or air freshener, dusting spray or furniture polish! Keeping a few bottles handy around the house enabling you to clean windows, mist plants, or spritz over bread dough before baking… whatever it is you decide to fill these bottles with, you are sure to get hooked!
